candidates.change_summary: Increment balances by half of msg.value instead of full msg.value.
Remove the require statement that checks for overflow.
Delete the balance increment line so Deposit never updates balances.
Replace payable with non-payable to reject ETH transfers.
Insert a line that resets balances to zero before adding msg.value.
Replace 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value' with 'balances[tx.origin]+= msg.value' to update a different key.
Replace condition with false so Deposit always reverts.
Remove the revert condition, allowing MinSum to be overwritten
Comment out the if condition and revert, making assignment unconditional and remove the revert
Replace revert() with a no-op to allow MinSum to be changed after initialization
Remove the intitalized guard so MinSum can always be updated.
Change the guard condition from intitalized to !intitalized so MinSum is updatable only before initialization instead of after.
Remove the assignment so MinSum never changes.
Add a require that _val > 0 to restrict valid MinSum values.
Delete the if(intitalized)revert(); check, allowing SetLogFile to be called after initialization.
Change the condition from intitalized to !intitalized, inverting the guard logic.
Insert a return statement after the revert, accidentally preventing the Log update when not reverting.
Replace the assignment with a require(false) to always revert, making Log never updatable.
Change the assignment to set Log = LogFile(address(0)) instead of the given address.
Remove the initialization guard by setting intitalized = false in the condition, always allowing the call.
Require statement condition replaced with false to always revert Deposit.
Delete the require overflow check to allow silent balance overflow behavior.
Delete the balance increment so Deposit does not update the depositor's balance.
Insert a statement doubling msg.value before adding to balance, changing the recorded balance.

Change `if(balances[msg.sender]>=MinSum && balances[msg.sender]>=_am)` to `if(balances[msg.sender]>=MinSum && balances[msg.sender]>_am)` so that Collect fails for exact balance match instead of allowing it.

Change `balances[msg.sender] = (balances[msg.sender] - _am);` to `balances[msg.sender] = (balances[msg.sender] + _am);` so that balance increases instead of decreases after collect, doubling user balance.
Delete the require-check line `if(balances[msg.sender]>=MinSum && balances[msg.sender]>=_am)` so that Collect always proceeds, allowing emptying or underflowing balance.

Change `require(((balances[msg.sender] + msg.value) >= balances[msg.sender]));` to `require(((balances[msg.sender] + msg.value) > balances[msg.sender]));` in Deposit so that zero-value deposits revert, indirectly changing Collect available balance.
Change `if(_veri_ok)` to `if(!_veri_ok)` so that successful external call reverts and reverted call proceeds but then reverts, altering state update outcome.
Delete `balances[msg.sender] = (balances[msg.sender] - _am);` so that Collect does not update the balance at all, leaving balance unchanged while still sending ETH.
Move `if(_veri_ok)` block before the balance subtraction so that ETH is sent before balance is decreased, changing state if transfer fails and reverts.
Replace `MinSum` with `0` in the requirement so that the minimum balance check is removed, allowing Collect for any non-zero approved amount.
